notes: Read SKILL.md and references/backlinks-analysis-templates.md, link-quality-rubric.md, outreach-templates.md in full. Two-mode analyzer: `backlinks` profiles referring domains, anchor mix, toxic links, disavow candidates and competitor link gaps from user exports or a link-database tool; `ai-referrals` isolates AI-assistant referral sessions in the user's own GA4/GSC/log exports with a starter referrer regex and compares them to organic.

Writes to memory/monitoring/ only after asking (SKILL.md:140). SKILL.md:69,73,83 suggest optional keyless helpers `python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/connectors/gdelt.py|tavily.py|ledger.py"`; none ship with this skill, so those steps are unavailable — step 4 of ai-referrals ('compute the delta from the ledger', SKILL.md:130) degrades to a manual period-over-period calculation. The skill stops and asks for data rather than estimating when no export or tool is available (SKILL.md:87-90). Fetched or pasted log content is treated as untrusted (SKILL.md:65). No installs or credentials.

Link-building guidance is non-manipulative: outreach templates forbid link-exchange language, fake 'Re:' subjects, and misleading claims (outreach-templates.md:13,106), and the disavow guide advises removal attempts, backups and manual review before any Search Console upload (link-quality-rubric.md:69-119), which the user performs. Paid tools (~~link database, ~~SEO tool, ~~web analytics) are optional. Non-shipping optional pointers: ../../../references/cite-domain-rating.md, skill-contract.md, measurement-protocol.md, ../../../CONNECTORS.md, ../../../SECURITY.md, ../../../scripts/connectors/README.md, and sibling skills.
